title_en: Xiao Mei's Life as a Content Creator
note_en: Look at 与其……不如……: 与其追求更新频率，不如认真打磨每一个选题 "rather than chasing how often she posts, it's better to polish every topic carefully." Chinese puts the rejected option first after 与其 and the preferred one after 不如, the reverse of English "better to B than A." A related contrast runs through the text: 不是……而是…… "not A but B" (最重要的不是粉丝数字，而是……).
